guidance: Honestly handle a common objection or hesitation an owner has about automation/marketing (cost, complexity, 'it feels impersonal'). Build trust. For done-for-you cost objections: never give numbers; the honest answer is that pricing follows a diagnosis meeting.
evidence_note: Transparent and honest; no unsupported guarantees, no done-for-you pricing.
reason: Balancing the mix: 'Objection Handling / Audience Nurture' was the most under-served eligible category (target 6%, recent 3%).
post_rationale: Carousels still lead saves/depth for B2B authority content in 2026 benchmarks, and this resolves a genuinely unclaimed objection (data lock-in fear on cancellation) distinct from the impersonal, cost, timing, complexity, staff-redundancy, tried-and-failed, and contract-lock-in objections already shipped.

guidance: State a sharp, defensible point of view or contrarian take on how service businesses actually grow. Confident, specific, never gimmicky engagement-bait.
evidence_note: Framed clearly as Black Arrow's view; no fabricated proof.
reason: Balancing the mix: 'Contrarian / Brand Point of View' was the most under-served eligible category (target 5%, recent 0%).
post_rationale: Reels still win reach for cold-audience POV content, and this ships an unclaimed reframe (treat automated follow-up as a producing employee, not a cost) distinct from every prior memory/systems and booking-friction reframe already shipped.
